(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i)  := by
  intro d e f h
  have step (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (hab : relation a b) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ (b i - a i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    refine (congrArg (fun n : ℤ => 7 ∣ n) ?_).mp (((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i)
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [← sub_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, ite_mul, zero_mul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hd := step d e h.1
  have he := step e f h.2
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hs
  rw [← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d] at hs
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    exact (dvd_sub hs (dvd_mul_right (7 : ℤ) (digits_to_num d))).trans ⟨1, by ring⟩
  intro i
  have hi : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    exact (dvd_sub hsum (dvd_add (hd i) (he i))).trans ⟨1, by ring⟩
  exact (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from by decide).pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hi
